name: Picsart
description_en:
Picsart combines photo editing, templates and stock assets with AI image and video generation across web and apps.

Its consumer creator plans should be assessed separately from the Enterprise API/editor SDK offer, with particular care around model credits, public sharing and commercial asset labels.
description_zh:
Picsart 将照片编辑、模板和图库素材与网页及 App 的 AI 图像、视频生成结合。

消费者创作套餐需要与 Enterprise API/编辑器 SDK 分开评估，重点核对模型点数、公开分享和素材商业许可标签。

core_features.explanation_en: The editor guide combines crop/resize/effects with background removal, object removal, AI Replace and enhancement before export.
core_features.explanation_zh: 编辑器指南将裁切、缩放、效果与背景移除、物体移除、AI Replace、增强及导出结合。

core_features.explanation_zh: 现行价格卡片列出 Pro 每批 50 张、100 GB，Ultra 每批 100 张、每席位 300 GB。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free basic features; dedicated annual Pro displayed $10.50 monthly equivalent/500 credits; selected Ultra $60 per seat equivalent/2,500 credits. Checkout currency/annual total/renewal not confirmed; editor embeds different Ultra offer. WAN 3.0 promotion expires October 31,2026 PT and excludes automation.

sections.title_en: From a photograph to a finished visual
sections.en:
Picsart’s photo-editor guide starts with upload or a blank canvas, then editing tools, AI enhancement and export. It documents crop and resize, filters, text and stickers, perspective correction and focus/blur controls. Background Remover isolates a subject, AI Replace generates replacement content and Remove Object cleans an unwanted area; the same platform also offers model-based image generation.

For an illustrative product promotion, first crop and correct the source photograph, remove the background, inspect the mask, add licensed design elements and export a channel-sized version. Check generated surfaces, text and product geometry against the original before publishing. This sequence is editorial guidance built from documented operations; no actual project, mask, color profile or export was tested. It should not be treated as proof that a generated product image accurately represents the item.
sections.zh:
Picsart 照片编辑器指南从上传或空白画布开始，接着使用编辑工具、AI 增强并导出。文档列出裁切、缩放、滤镜、文字、贴纸、透视校正和焦点/模糊控制。Background Remover 用于隔离主体，AI Replace 生成替换内容，Remove Object 清除不需要的区域；同一平台也提供基于模型的图像生成。

以商品促销为假设场景，可先裁切并调整原片、移除背景、检查蒙版，再加入有许可的设计元素并导出适合渠道尺寸的版本。发布前应将生成的表面、文字和商品几何与原片对照。这是根据已记录操作组织的编辑建议，没有实际测试项目、蒙版、色彩配置或导出，不能证明生成商品图准确代表实物。

sections.title_en: Current creator pricing and a conflicting embedded card
sections.title_zh: 当前创作套餐与冲突的嵌入卡片
sections.en:
The dedicated pricing page and its actual browser state showed Pro at $10.50 per month equivalent billed yearly, with 500 monthlycredits. The selected Ultra configuration showed $60 per month equivalent billed yearly per seat,2,500 monthlycredits, and other selectable credit amounts. The page used a dollar symbol without establishing checkout currency here; no annual checkout total or renewal price was independently confirmed.

Pro lists 50-image batches,3+brand kits and 100 GB storage; Ultra lists 100-image batches,10+brand kits and 300 GB per seat. Some comparison rows still list 50-image batches without distinguishing tiers. More materially, the photo-editor page embeds an Ultra $24.50 annual-equivalent offer and “coming soon” MCP/agent text, while the dedicated pricing page shows $60 for its selected configuration and presents those capabilities as available. These pages differ in configuration and freshness; do not combine their lowest prices and broadest features into a single verified plan. Confirm the intended seat, credits and tool at checkout.
sections.zh:
专门价格页及其实际浏览器状态显示 Pro 年付折合每月 $10.50，每月 500 点。选中的 Ultra 配置为年付、每席位折合每月 $60，每月 2,500 点，并提供其他点数选项。此处页面使用美元符号，但未建立结账货币；没有独立确认年付实扣总额或续费价。

Pro 列出每批 50 张、3+ 品牌资料和 100 GB；Ultra 列出每批 100 张、10+ 品牌资料和每席位 300 GB。部分比较行仍统一写 50 张，未区分档位。更明显的是，照片编辑器页嵌入 Ultra 年付折合 $24.50 的卡片，并将 MCP/Agent 标成“即将推出”，而专门价格页选中配置是 $60，且把这些能力描述为已提供。两页的配置和新鲜度不同，不能将最低价与最广功能拼成一个已核实套餐。结账时需确认席位、点数和目标工具。

sections.title_en: WAN 3.0 unlimited is a dated, channel-limited promotion
sections.title_zh: WAN 3.0 无限活动有日期和渠道限制
sections.en:
The separate promotion terms set an end time of October 31,2026 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time. Active paid Pro and Ultra users, including paid Ultra seats and app-store subscribers, can make eligible WAN 3.0 generations on the Picsart website and apps without credit charges during the period. API, CLI, MCP, third-party integration, script and bot generations are excluded and use normal credits. Other models remain metered as usual.

“Unlimited” still allows fair-use, concurrency, hourly/daily, queue and priority limits. Starting November 1 at 12:00 a.m. Pacific Time, WAN 3.0 uses normal credits; submissions before the cutoff are covered even if they finish afterward. The offer does not change subscription renewal prices or extend the billing period. That makes it unsuitable as a permanent cost assumption for an automated production pipeline. The exact limits and generation latency were not tested.
sections.zh:
独立活动条款将结束时间定为太平洋时间 2026 年 10 月 31 日晚 11:59。有效付费 Pro 和 Ultra 用户，包括 Ultra 付费席位及应用商店订阅用户，在活动期内可通过 Picsart 网站和 App 发起符合条件的 WAN 3.0 生成而不扣点数。API、CLI、MCP、第三方集成、脚本和机器人生成被排除，按正常点数计费；其他模型照常计量。

“无限”仍允许合理使用、并发、每小时/每天、排队和优先级限制。从太平洋时间 11 月 1 日零点起，WAN 3.0 恢复正常扣点；截止前提交的任务即使之后完成也适用活动。优惠不会改变订阅续费价或延长账期，因此不适合作为自动化生产管线的长期成本假设。具体限制和生成延迟未实测。

sections.title_en: A community image is not automatically cleared for business
sections.title_zh: 社区图片不自动获得商业许可
sections.en:
The June 30,2023 terms distinguish the user’s content, ordinary Picsart Content and content expressly marked for commercial use. Ordinary Picsart Content is licensed for personal/noncommercial use; commercial derivatives need the appropriate commercial-use identification. A community #freetoedit label grants personal/noncommercial reuse, whereas #freeforbusiness grants broader commercial reuse subject to platform functionality and the uploader’s rights. A subscription does not replace that distinction.

Users retain their rights, while granting Picsart a service/business content license subject to privacy settings. Shared material can remain in other users’ works after deletion or a switch to private. For client work, verify asset labels and permissions and decide whether sharing is appropriate before making the project public. The terms’ age and newer AI model lineup leave model-specific output rights unresolved in this draft; no blanket copyright or non-infringement guarantee is inferred.
sections.zh:
2023 年 6 月 30 日条款区分用户内容、普通 Picsart Content 和明确标为可商用的内容。普通 Picsart Content 许可用于个人、非商业用途，商业衍生作品需要相应商业使用标识。社区的 #freetoedit 标签授予个人、非商业再使用，#freeforbusiness 则在平台功能及上传者权利范围内授予更广商业使用。订阅不能代替这种区分。

用户保留自身权利，同时按隐私设置向 Picsart 授予服务/业务内容许可。分享内容在删除或转为私密后，仍可能保留在其他用户的作品中。客户项目应先核对素材标签、权限和是否适合分享，再将项目公开。条款日期较早，而 AI 模型列表已更新，因此各模型输出的具体权利仍未在本稿建立，不能推断有全面版权或不侵权保证。

sections.title_en: Seats, devices and cancellation are separate questions
sections.title_zh: 席位、设备与取消是不同问题
sections.en:
The service terms say subscriptions are single-user unless explicitly multi-user and describe access on up to ten devices on one operating system. Current pricing separately offers Ultra team seats and web/mobile project access. Device counts are not permission to share one subscription among a team, and exact current cross-platform purchase behavior needs confirmation.

Subscriptions renew until canceled. Web users cancel through their account; app-store purchases may need store cancellation. Access generally continues to the period’s end and payments are described as nonrefundable under the terms. Picsart Enterprise APIs and editor SDKs are a separate product route; the WAN promotion explicitly excludes automated channels even though creator plans now advertise CLI/MCP. API price packages from the separate Enterprise listing were not imported into this consumer record.
sections.zh:
服务条款说，除明确允许多人外，订阅按单用户授权，并描述同一操作系统上最多十台设备访问。现行价格页另提供 Ultra 团队席位和网页/移动项目访问。设备数不代表团队可共用一个订阅，当前跨平台购买行为仍需确认。

订阅会持续续费直到取消。网页用户通过账户取消，应用商店购买可能需要通过商店取消。访问通常持续到周期结束，条款将付款列为不可退款。Picsart Enterprise API 和编辑器 SDK 属于另一产品路径；即使创作套餐现在宣传 CLI/MCP，WAN 活动仍明确排除自动化渠道。本消费者记录没有套用独立 Enterprise 产品的 API 价格包。
